issue_context.title: EVP_set_default_properties() does not work
comments:
The issue is multi-faceted...

1.  When a NULL (or possibly also an empty) propquery is passed, the global properties aren't considered, at all:

    https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/c72e59349f50ee00a1bf8605ada17dfccb8b3b1a/crypto/property/property.c#L326-L354

2.  The global properties are stored in the METHOD store rather than the library context.  This would be fine if we knew that we have only one METHOD store per library context, but that isn't the case; any time we fetch new methods from the provider, we do so to a temporary store that is created during the fetch and destroyed before the fetch is finished.  We do this to deal with no-cache implementations in a uniform manner.

    The solution *should* be to store the global properties in the library context.
Re: the first problem: lines 326 through 332 should be deleted and the search forced.
and, no doubt, deal with the carnage that follows....
